lines.en: Somewhere in the urban district, beneath a shining star...
lines.zh: 在市区的某个地方,一颗闪耀的星之下……

lines.en: : Hey, sorry I’m late. I ran into an issue with a pair of handcuffs.
lines.zh: : 嘿,抱歉来晚了。我在一副手铐上遇到了点麻烦。

lines.en: : No worries. Any time your punctuality takes a hit I kind of just assume it’s due to some BDSM-related mishap. Also, I invited Karin. Hope that’s cool.
lines.zh: : 没关系。你的守时但凡出问题,我基本都会默认是某种 BDSM 相关的事故。另外,我把 Karin 叫来了。希望没意见。

lines.en: : Heeeey. That’s me. I’m the other girl from the swimsuit contest thing who also felt like it should have been canceled but wasn’t able to speak up because I want my sister to like me. Nice to meet you.
lines.zh: : 嘿————。说的就是我。我是泳装比赛那件事里的另一个女孩,同样觉得比赛该取消、却因为想让姐姐喜欢我没敢出声的那位。初次见面。

lines.en: : Nice to meet you as well. Now go home. My quota for human contact today caps out at one person and Imani already counts as at least four.
lines.zh: : 我也很高兴认识你。现在回家吧。我今天的人类接触额度只有一个人,而 Imani 至少已经算四个了。

lines.en: : Yo, chill. Karin isn’t going anywhere. She still needs a Halloween costume too and she’s part of the “I know Imani is a monster underneath her clothes” club.
lines.zh: : 哟,淡定。Karin 哪也不去。她也还需要一套万圣节装扮,而且她是「我知道 Imani 衣服底下是个怪物」俱乐部的一员。

lines.en: : I actually like your scars. They add personality. But I suppose that is a double-edged sword as you already have too much of that to begin with.
lines.zh: : 我其实挺喜欢你的伤疤。它们增加了个性。不过我想那是把双刃剑——你的个性本来就有点太多了。

lines.en: : You could have just introduced me as a member of the swim club too...that would have worked.
lines.zh: : 你直接介绍我是游泳部的不就行了……那样也能行。

lines.en: : Yeah, maybe in the context of a situation where I’d be keeping my clothes on. But it’s not like I can just throw a hat on and go to this year’s party as “Hat Imani.”
lines.zh: : 嗯,在「我穿着衣服」的场合也许行。但我总不能随便扣顶帽子、就以「帽子 Imani」的身份去今年的派对吧。

lines.en: : I think Hat Imani sounds cute. It’s like normal Imani just...there’s a hat. And it’s...
lines.zh: : 我觉得「帽子 Imani」挺可爱的。就像普通的 Imani,只是……多了顶帽子。而且它……

lines.en: : The hat is on her.
lines.zh: : 帽子在她头上。

lines.en: : Is this what you wanted? If we needed someone awkward, we could have just invited Rika. At least she’s of age.
lines.zh: : 这是你想要的吗?要是我们需要一个尴尬精,直接请 Rika 就行。至少她到了年纪。

lines.en: : I’m sorry. I’ll try to be better.
lines.zh: : 对不起。我会努力变好的。

lines.en: : Damn it, Wakana. Now look what you’ve done. You’ve made the only wholesome girl in all of Kumon-mi sad. And if you wind up being the one to lead her down a dark path, I won’t ever forgive you.
lines.zh: : 该死,Wakana。看看你干的好事。你把全 Kumon-mi 唯一一个纯良的女孩弄伤心了。如果你最后把她带上歧路,我永远不会原谅你。

lines.en: : Forgiveness be damned. I will not follow in the footsteps of you and Arakawa by spending what little free time I have with students. I have better things to do.
lines.zh: : 原谅个鬼。我不会步你和 Arakawa 的后尘、把仅有的闲暇耗在学生身上。我还有更要紧的事。

lines.en: : Bro, we’re just buying costumes. It’s not like we’re inviting her out to the bar.
lines.zh: : 哥,我们只是买装扮。又不是请她去酒吧。

lines.en: : But hey, even if we were, she’d probably just bail on me last minute anyway since that is apparently what you guys do now.
lines.zh: : 再说,就算请了,她八成也会在最后一刻放我鸽子——毕竟那显然是你们现在的常规操作。

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m looking at you.
lines.zh: : 对,我说的就是你。

lines.en: : I had nothing to do with that. It was Rika’s idea.
lines.zh: : 那事和我没有任何关系。那是 Rika 的主意。

lines.en: : Mmmmmhm. Well, thanks. I’m sure it went down exactly how she wanted it to.
lines.zh: : 嗯————哼。行,谢了。我确信事情正如她所愿地发展了。

lines.en: : Was there...some sort of issue recently? Is it something I’m allowed to know?
lines.zh: : 最近……出什么事了吗?是我能知道的事吗?

lines.en: : Hah. There’s a guy I like, but the guy doesn’t like me. Or...does like me, but also likes someone else.
lines.zh: : 哈。我喜欢上一个人,但那个人不喜欢我。或者……也喜欢我,但也喜欢别人。

lines.en: : So he doesn’t want to like me any harder than he currently likes me because it might make us like each other less. Even though I currently want him to like me so hard that it shatters my pelvis.
lines.zh: : 所以他不愿比现在更喜欢我,因为那可能让我们俩的喜欢互相抵消。尽管我此刻想让他喜欢我喜欢到骨盆碎裂。

lines.en: : Adult relationships sound complicated. I didn’t even know that you could like someone with...that amount of force.
lines.zh: : 成年人的感情听起来好复杂。我甚至不知道喜欢一个人还能……用那么大的力气。

lines.en: : Because, again, you are the only wholesome girl in this entire city. So make sure you don’t listen to anything Wakana says as her world view may accidentally gothify you.
lines.zh: : 因为,再说一遍,你是全城唯一纯良的女孩。所以千万别听 Wakana 的任何话——她的世界观可能会不小心把你也哥特化。

lines.en: : Everything I do is for the greater good. Which is why the first place on our list today is one of my favorite shops.
lines.zh: : 我做的一切都是为了更大的善。这也是为什么今天行程的第一站,是我最喜欢的店之一。

lines.en: : If I am going to gothify anyone I would prefer it happens early before my medication begins to wear off.
lines.zh: : 如果我要哥特化谁,我倒希望趁药效还没开始消退,尽早发生。

lines.en: : Good. The sooner I can get away from these nine million Niki posters, the better.
lines.zh: : 很好。我越早摆脱这九百万张 Niki 海报越好。

lines.en: : You hear that, Niki?! Just because you’re hot and talented doesn’t mean I have to like you! Get bent!
lines.zh: : 听见了吗,Niki?!就因为你又美又有才,我就必须喜欢你吗?!去你的吧!

lines.en: : Oh, good. She has a rival now. Cute.
lines.zh: : 哦,好啊。她现在有宿敌了。可爱。

lines.en: : Wow. I had no idea Miss Imai hated pop music this much.
lines.zh: : 哇。我都不知道 Imai 小姐这么讨厌流行乐。

lines.en: : I'm glad she does. It will make it easier to convert her into one of my people.
lines.zh: : 我很高兴她讨厌。这会让她更容易皈依我们一族。

lines.en: : Now, come. Both of you.
lines.zh: : 那么,走吧。你们两位。

lines.en: : You haven’t seen the last of me, Niki! I’ll be back!
lines.zh: : 你还没摆脱我呢,Niki!我会回来的!

lines.en: : Come on, Miss Imai. If you yell at the billboards any longer, people will think you’re crazy. Then no one will want to like you as hard as you apparently want to be liked.
lines.zh: : 走吧,Imai 小姐。你要是再冲广告牌吼下去,人们会以为你疯了。那样就没人会像你显然渴望的那样、狠狠地喜欢你了。

lines.en: : What was your name again? Karin?
lines.zh: : 你叫什么来着?Karin?

lines.en: : Yes! Hello!
lines.zh: : 是!你好!

lines.en: : Grab her.
lines.zh: : 抓住她。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么?

lines.en: : Grab her. You’re tall and...powerful looking. And I am not about to be delayed by a woman too busy yelling at signs to remember we are here on a mission.
lines.zh: : 抓住她。你个子高,而且……看起来很有力量。我可不想被一个忙着冲招牌吼叫、忘了我们是来办正事的女人拖住。

lines.en: : I’m coming, damn it! I just needed to get my midday fury out of the way first.
lines.zh: : 这就来,该死!我只是想先把正午的怒火发完。

lines.en: : Wow...everything here is so...scary...
lines.zh: : 哇……这里的一切都好……吓人……

lines.en: : It looks like a normal gothic lolita place to me.
lines.zh: : 在我看来就是一家普通的哥特萝莉塔店。

lines.en: : Yes, isn’t it wonderful?
lines.zh: : 是吧,很棒吧?

lines.en: : Now, I’m all for trying on a bunch of random shit and looking horrible in like 99%% of it, but I’m not sure if I like the idea of people thinking my Halloween costume is just “Black Wakana.”
lines.zh: : 好,我完全支持乱试一堆东西、然后在其中九成九里丑得惊天动地,但我不太喜欢别人以为我的万圣节装扮就是「黑色 Wakana」。

lines.en: : Why not? It’s better than “Hat Imani.”
lines.zh: : 为什么?总比「帽子 Imani」强。

lines.en: : I like Hat Imani! It’s like normal Imani, just-
lines.zh: : 我喜欢帽子 Imani!就像普通的 Imani,只是——

lines.en: : With a hat. We know. Now, go run along and look at all of the dresses.
lines.zh: : 多了顶帽子。我们知道了。去去,自己逛裙子去。

lines.en: : Okay!
: And whatever you do, don’t go into the back room. That is for adults only.
lines.zh: : 还有,无论你做什么,别进后屋。那是只限成人的。

lines.en: : Got it! I like rules!
lines.zh: : 明白!我喜欢规矩!

lines.en: : Wakana, what kind of place did you take me to that has an “adults only” back room? I thought we were costume shopping.
lines.zh: : Wakana,你带我来的是什么地方,还有个「只限成人」的后屋?我们不是来买装扮的吗?

lines.en: : We are. It just also happens to be in the same place where I shop for chains and lingerie for Osako’s secret boudoir photo shoots.
lines.zh: : 我们是。只是这家店恰好也是我给 Osako 的秘密私房照采购锁链和内衣的地方。

lines.en: : And which one of you is the photographer?
lines.zh: : 那你们俩谁是摄影师?

lines.en: : Yes.
lines.zh: : 都是。

lines.en: : God damn I need to get laid.
lines.zh: : 老天,我真需要来一发。

lines.en: : Well, that’s on you for not taking your new rival up on her offer. You had your chance and squandered it.
lines.zh: : 嗯,谁叫你不接受新宿敌的提议。机会给过你,是你自己浪费的。

lines.en: : Yeah, I know. The six hours of listening to the two of them go at it is etched so deep into my memory at this point that I can pretty much replay the whole night in my head.
lines.zh: : 是,我知道。听那两位激战六个小时的体验,已经深深刻进我的记忆,我几乎能在脑内回放那一整晚。

lines.en: : Lucky.
lines.zh: : 真幸运。

lines.en: : Wakana, is it weird to ask somebody to have friend-sex with you?
lines.zh: : Wakana,开口请人和你「朋友间做爱」很怪吗?

lines.en: : Well, you’ve certainly chosen a strange time to start hitting on me.
lines.zh: : 嗯,你挑的搭讪时机可真别致。

lines.en: : Not you. Senpai.
lines.zh: : 不是你。是 Senpai。

lines.en: : You asked Arakawa to have sex with you?
lines.zh: : 你请 Arakawa 和你做爱?

lines.en: : I’m not proud of it, okay? I just wanted to...test how much he’s actually into this idol friend of his.
lines.zh: : 我并不为此骄傲,好吗?我只是想……测试一下,他对他那位偶像朋友到底陷得多深。

lines.en: : But...you would have followed through with it if he’d agreed, yes?
lines.zh: : 可是……如果他答应了,你会跟进的,对吧?

lines.en: : Oh God yeah. I ain’t no baby-back bitch.
lines.zh: : 哦天,当然。我才不是软脚虾。

lines.en: : Then...I take it you’ve already revealed your body to him?
lines.zh: : 那么……我猜你已经向他展示过你的身体了?

lines.en: : I...have not.
lines.zh: : 我……没有。

lines.en: : Were you hoping he’d just...keep his eyes closed the entire time, then? Or are you so desperate for sex at this point that you’re willing to just overlook your self-image issues if it means relieving your tension?
lines.zh: : 那你是打算让他……全程闭着眼?还是说你如今饥渴到,只要能泄压,连自我形象的问题都可以暂时无视了?

lines.en: : The former. And if he did not agree, I would have blindfolded him. I have several bandanas I have been saving for such an occasion.
lines.zh: : 前者。他要是不同意,我就蒙上他的眼。我攒着好几条方巾,专门为这种场合准备的。

lines.en: : You’re really deep into this, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你陷得真深,不是吗?

lines.en: : Yeah, but it’s not like I want to be. I love what he and I have right now. You know that. I just...fucking...
lines.zh: : 是,但我不想要这样。我很珍惜我和他现在拥有的东西。你知道的。我只是……他妈的……

lines.en: : Ughhhhhhhhhhh! Why did I ask him that?! I made everything wooooooorse!
lines.zh: : 唉————!我为什么要问他那个?!我把一切都弄得更————糟了!

lines.en: : I’m sure Arakawa didn’t mind...If anything, I imagine he took it as a compliment.
lines.zh: : 我确信 Arakawa 不会介意……要我说,他多半把那当成恭维。

lines.en: : Just...keep in mind that you aren’t the problem. He did say he likes you, didn’t he?
lines.zh: : 只要记住,问题不在你。他确实说过喜欢你,不是吗?

lines.en: : Yeah...just not hard enough.
lines.zh: : 是……只是喜欢得不够狠。

lines.en: : The timing is just wrong, Imani. That happens sometimes. It’s not as if your life is over.
lines.zh: : 只是时机不对,Imani。这种事时有发生。你的天又没塌。

lines.en: : Ughhhhhhhh but it feels like it iiiiiiiiiis.
: Moaning and groaning will get you nowhere. But do you know what will?
lines.zh: : 哀嚎抱怨没有任何用。但你知道什么有用吗?

lines.en: : Putting on a dress that’s way too big for me and then having you repeatedly tell me that I’d make a good goth when we all know I wouldn’t?
lines.zh: : 穿上一件我完全撑不起来的大裙子,然后让你反复告诉我「我会是个好哥特」,而我们都知道我不会?

lines.en: : Exactly.
lines.zh: : 正是。

lines.en: : Hah...
: Black Wakana here I come...
lines.zh: : 黑色 Wakana,我来了……

lines.en: : You know what? It’s probably good that Senpai turned down the friend-sex.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗?Senpai 拒绝了朋友间做爱,说不定是好事。

lines.en: : Christ, are we still on this? I thought we were done.
lines.zh: : 天,这事还没完?我以为翻篇了。

lines.en: : Think about it, though. Like, he’s boning an idol. And he’s not just boning her, he’s boning her a lot. I don’t have that kind of stamina. No way I’d be able to go that long.
lines.zh: : 但你想想。就是说,他在和一个偶像上床。而且不只是上床,是上得很勤。我没有那种耐力。我绝对撑不了那么久。

lines.en: : So, all things considered, if he did screw me, he’d probably just think, “Ehh. I’ve had better. Also, what’s with the blindfold?” and then it would just end.
lines.zh: : 所以,综合来看,他要是真上了我,多半只会想「呃,有过更好的。还有,蒙眼是怎么回事?」,然后就这么结束。

lines.en: : At least this way, we get to stay friends. And I can just keep hoping they break up or something and I can get him on the rebound when his standards are lower.
lines.zh: : 至少这样,我们还能做朋友。而我还可以继续盼着他们分手什么的,趁他眼光变低,捞个反弹。

lines.en: : Are you done? Can we move on now?
lines.zh: : 说完了?现在能继续了吗?

lines.en: : Well, excuse me, princess. I didn’t realize there was a limit on how long I was allowed to talk about my feelings for.
lines.zh: : 哦,抱歉啊,公主殿下。我不知道谈论自己的感情还有时长限制。

lines.en: : There’s no strict limit. But a time must come when you think to yourself, “You know what? I’ve been speaking for 75%% of the day and it is possible my friend might have something to say as well.”
lines.zh: : 没有硬性限制。但总得有个时刻,你会想到「你猜怎么着?我今天说了一整天的话,占百分之七十五,我的朋友可能也有话要说」。

lines.en: : Well, do you?
lines.zh: : 嗯,那你有吗?

lines.en: : Do you not wear underwear with that outfit?
lines.zh: : 你穿那身衣服不穿内裤吗?

lines.en: : That’s what you want to talk about? When I do and don’t wear underwear?
lines.zh: : 这就是你想聊的?我什么时候穿、什么时候不穿内裤?

lines.en: : It wasn’t originally. But I can’t help but bring it up now that you’re exposing your genitals to me.
lines.zh: : 本来不是。但你把私处亮给我看,我实在忍不住要提。

lines.en: : Well, ignoring my genitals, what was it you had to say?
lines.zh: : 嗯,忽略我的私处,你刚想说的事是什么?

lines.en: : I can’t remember.
lines.zh: : 我忘了。

lines.en: : That feeling when I’m closer to friend-sex with you than I am with Senpai.
lines.zh: : 那种感觉——我和你离「朋友间做爱」,比和 Senpai 还近。

lines.en: : Wait, I remember now. And it should still pique your interest to some extent as Arakawa is still a part of it.
lines.zh: : 等等,我想起来了。而且它应该多少还能引起你的兴趣,因为 Arakawa 也在其中。

lines.en: : If it has anything to do with him having sex with anyone other than me, I don’t want to hear it. I know too much already.
lines.zh: : 只要是关于他和除我以外的任何人做爱,我都不想听。我已经知道得太多了。

lines.en: : Rest assured, it does not. In fact, it has more to do with his niece than it does with him.
lines.zh: : 放心,不是。实际上,它更多和他的侄女有关,而不是他。

lines.en: : Ami? Why do you want to talk about Ami?
lines.zh: : Ami?你为什么要谈 Ami?

lines.en: : You’re aware that she won my poetry contest, correct?
lines.zh: : 你知道她赢了我的诗歌比赛,对吧?

lines.en: : I am. I’m shocked as well given how she fares in every subject other than creative writing, but still. I’m aware.
lines.zh: : 知道。我也很震惊——考虑到她在创意写作以外的每一科的表现。但我知道。

lines.en: : And are you familiar with a poet who goes by the name “The Girl Who Cannot Breathe?”
lines.zh: : 那你熟悉一位笔名叫「无法呼吸的女孩」的诗人吗?

lines.en: : That, I am not. Poetry isn’t really one of my areas of expertise the way it is for you. But why do you ask? Do you think Ami may have been plagiarizing or something?
lines.zh: : 那个我不熟。诗歌不像对你那样,算不上我的专长。但你为什么问?你觉得 Ami 可能抄袭了什么?

lines.en: : It’s hard to say. The situation is...complicated.
lines.zh: : 不好说。情况……有点复杂。

lines.en: : Complicated?
lines.zh: : 复杂?

lines.en: : Before I say any more, I need you to promise that you won’t repeat any of this to Arakawa. He’s rather...touchy when it comes to this subject.
lines.zh: : 在我多说之前,我需要你保证不向 Arakawa 复述任何内容。涉及这个话题,他相当……碰不得。

lines.en: : Senpai is touchy with something? But his whole thing is never being able to show any emotion about anything.
lines.zh: : Senpai 有碰不得的话题?可他的招牌不就是对任何事都摆不出情绪吗?

lines.en: : Yes, well...I seem to have found the one area where that is not the case.
lines.zh: : 是,这个嘛……我似乎找到了唯一的例外。

lines.en: : Then, yeah. I won’t say anything to him. What’s up?
lines.zh: : 那好,行。我不会对他说。什么事?

lines.en: : Well, Ami’s work is remarkably similar to that of The Girl Who Cannot Breathe. So much so that I did initially worry that plagiarism could be at play.
lines.zh: : 嗯,Ami 的作品和「无法呼吸的女孩」的作品惊人地相似。相似到我起初确实担心是不是有抄袭。

lines.en: : But now you think it’s not?
lines.zh: : 但现在你不这么想了?

lines.en: : Miss Imai? Miss Watabe? Can I come in?
lines.zh: : Imai 小姐?Watabe 小姐?我能进来吗?

lines.en: : Yeah, you’re good.
lines.zh: : 可以,进吧。

lines.en: : Thanks. And sorry to be a Debbie Downer, but I don’t think I’m going to find anything here. It seems like everything is mostly tailored to more...petite girls.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。抱歉当个扫兴人,但我觉得我在这儿找不到合适的。这里的一切似乎都更适合……娇小的女孩。

lines.en: : I haven’t even tried anything on yet. But go on, Wakana. Finish what you wanted to say.
lines.zh: : 我还没试穿任何一件呢。不过继续,Wakana。把你想说的说完。

lines.en: : Thank you. What I was in the process of saying is that I haven’t exactly ruled out plagiarism just yet, but I’m beginning to believe that this poet might actually be her mother.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。我刚才想说的是:我还没有完全排除抄袭,但我开始相信,这位诗人可能真的是她的母亲。

lines.en: : And that’s...an issue?
lines.zh: : 而……那是个问题?

lines.en: : It wouldn’t be an issue if it was just any poet. But the one in question had a remarkably grim view of the world that I fear may be...tainting one of your students. In an unhealthy way.
lines.zh: : 如果只是随便哪位诗人,那不算问题。但我们讨论的这位,对世界有着异乎寻常阴郁的见解——我担心那可能正在……污染你的一个学生。以不健康的方式。

lines.en: : Unhealthy how? Because if this is actually as dangerous as you’re making it sound, I should probably talk to her.
lines.zh: : 不健康是指?如果这事真有你说的那么危险,我也许该找她谈谈。

lines.en: : I’m glad you’re of the same mindset as me while Arakawa couldn’t be more opposed if he tried.
lines.zh: : 你能和我持同样的想法,真好。Arakawa 可是拼了命都要反对。

lines.en: : But what I mean by “unhealthy” is that The Girl Who Cannot Breathe makes Poe’s tastes seem tame by comparison.
lines.zh: : 但我说的「不健康」是指,相比之下,「无法呼吸的女孩」让 Poe 的趣味都显得温和。

lines.en: : Oh damn. That guy was into some weird shit too.
lines.zh: : 哦,糟。那位老兄的怪癖也够邪门的。

lines.en: : He was. But his tastes were not toxic, whereas the poet in question wanted people to feel the way she felt and empathize with these...disgusting, horrific ideals that just...
lines.zh: : 是。但他的趣味没有毒,而我们讨论的这位诗人,却想让人们感受她所感受的、共情这些……令人作呕的、可怖的理念,它们简直……

lines.en: : They’re things that are okay to admire from afar and through a critical lens where we can sit back and cherry pick where the flaws in her manner of thinking were.
lines.zh: : 那些东西,远远地隔着批判的透镜去欣赏没问题——我们可以坐下来,挑挑她思维方式里的毛病。

lines.en: : But if these thoughts, ideals, and mannerisms are being replicated, which I believe seems to be the case, there’s cause for concern in the spread of this parasitic mindset as a whole.
lines.zh: : 但如果这些念头、理念、习气正在被复制——而我认为这正是正在发生的——这种寄生式思维的传播,就值得警惕了。

lines.en: : And I think we need to get to her before it becomes too much to bear.
lines.zh: : 而我认为,我们得赶在这一切变得不堪重负之前,找到她。

lines.en: : Got it. I’ll read some of her stuff when I get home tonight to get a better idea of what you’re talking about. Then, we can figure out where to go from there.
lines.zh: : 明白。今晚回家我会读一些她的东西,更好地理解你在说什么。然后我们再商量下一步。

lines.en: : You’re absolutely positive this is serious though, right? Because anything involving her parents isn't something we should bring up unless we absolutely have to.
lines.zh: : 但你绝对确定这事严重,对吧?因为任何涉及她父母的事,除非万不得已,我们都不该提。

lines.en: : I think it could be. But that’s all we should need in order to intervene if Arakawa would rather let his niece just fall into a bottomless pit of debauchery without actually trying to stop it.
lines.zh: : 我认为可能严重。但只要 Arakawa 宁愿让他的侄女直接坠进无底的放纵深渊、而不真正设法阻止——这就足以成为我们干预的理由。

lines.en: : Wait, have you guys been talking about Ami’s mom this whole time?
lines.zh: : 等等,你们俩这一整晚都在聊 Ami 的妈妈?

lines.en: : Why? You don’t know something, do you?
lines.zh: : 怎么?你是不是知道点什么?

lines.en: : I don’t, but my dad might. He went to school with her.
lines.zh: : 我不知道,但我爸可能知道。他和她上过同一所学校。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么?

lines.en: : Is Ami okay? All that stuff about unhealthy ideals and...parasitic mindsets and stuff doesn’t really sound like-
lines.zh: : Ami 还好吗?什么「不健康的理念」「寄生思维」,听起来可不像——

lines.en: : Karin, how sure are you about this? How do you know?
lines.zh: : Karin,这件事你有多大把握?你怎么知道的?

lines.en: : I was showing my family pictures from the beach trip and my dad said Ami looked almost identical to a girl that used to be in his class.
lines.zh: : 我给家里人看海边旅行的照片,我爸说 Ami 和他班上一个女生长得几乎一模一样。

lines.en: : They didn’t have the same last name, so there was no way of being 100%% sure. But he seemed pretty adamant that she might be her daughter.
lines.zh: : 姓氏不一样,所以没法百分之百确定。但他相当坚持,说那可能是她女儿。

lines.en: : I was planning on just leaving it at that since Ami’s really sensitive about stuff involving her parents, but if you really think she’s in trouble, I can try to-
lines.zh: : 我本打算到此为止,毕竟 Ami 对涉及父母的事特别敏感——但你要是真觉得她有麻烦,我可以试着——

lines.en: : Don’t worry about Ami for now. Let’s leave her out of this until we have a little more to go off of.
lines.zh: : Ami 的事暂时不用担心。在我们掌握更多线索之前,先别把她卷进来。

lines.en: : Karin, can you provide me with your father’s phone number? I’d like to speak with him about this if that’s okay.
lines.zh: : Karin,能把你父亲的电话号码给我吗?如果方便,我想和他谈谈这件事。

lines.en: : Yeah...if that will help, sure. I’ll do anything I can.
lines.zh: : 好……要是有帮助的话,当然。我什么都愿意做。

lines.en: : That’s all you need to worry about for now, Karin. Wakana and I will take it from here.
lines.zh: : 眼下你操心的就这么多,Karin。剩下的交给我和 Wakana。

lines.en: : Imani is correct. But please, his number.
lines.zh: : Imani 说得对。不过请把号码给我。

lines.en: : Oh, right. It’s-
lines.zh: : 哦,对。号码是——
